title: Vickers Wellington HE159
memorial_details:
description: THIS MONUMENT IS/ ERECTED IN/ MEMORY OF/ SGT R.M. BUIE RCAF/ F/SGT A.W. KIMMERLEY RCAF/ P/O L.K. TAYLOR RCAF P/O/ R.W. THOMPSON/ CREW OF A WELLINGTON/ BOMBER OF 424(TIGER)/ SQUADRON RCAF/ WHO WERE KILLED/ ON 11TH APRIL 1943/ WHEN THEIR PLANE/ SUFFERED ENGINE/ FAILURE ON A/ BOMBING MISSION/ TO FRANKFURT

CRASHING ON/ HEXDEN MARSHES/ SOUTH OF THIS PLACE. ALSO REMEMBERING/ SGT A.G. LEES RCAF THE SOLE SURVIVOR/ WHO TRIED IN VAIN/ TO RESCUE HIS / COMRADES THIS MONUMENT / WAS UNVEILED / ON THE 6OTH / ANNIVERSARY / BY THE GRATEFUL/ PEOPLES OF CANADA/ AND ROLVENDEN/ AND PAID FOR BY/ PUBLIC SUBSCRIPTION

TO THE MEMORY/ OF/ ART LEES/ WHO ATTENDED THE UNVEILING/ OF THIS MONUMENT IN THE/ PRESENCE OF MANY ASSEMBLED/ AND WHO DIED PEACEFULLY/ AT HOME IN BRITISH COLUMBIA/ ON 17TH NOVEMBER 2004 AGED 84
